def sample_batch(user_train: dict, itemnum: int, batch_size: int, maxlen: int,
                 users=None, sample_negatives: bool = True):
    if users is None:
        users = [u for u, items in user_train.items() if len(items) >= 2]
    if not users:
        raise ValueError("Dataset has no training histories with two items")
    batch_seq, batch_pos, batch_neg = [], [], []
    for _ in range(batch_size):
        history = user_train[random.choice(users)]
        seq = np.zeros(maxlen, dtype=np.int32)
        pos = np.zeros(maxlen, dtype=np.int32)
        neg = np.zeros(maxlen, dtype=np.int32)
        nxt = history[-1]
        idx = maxlen - 1
        ts = set(history) if sample_negatives else set()
        can_sample = sample_negatives and len(ts) < itemnum
        for item in reversed(history[:-1]):
            seq[idx] = item
            pos[idx] = nxt
            if nxt != 0 and can_sample:
                neg_item = random.randint(1, itemnum)
                while neg_item in ts:
                    neg_item = random.randint(1, itemnum)
                neg[idx] = neg_item
            nxt = item
            idx -= 1
            if idx == -1:
                break
        batch_seq.append(seq)
        batch_pos.append(pos)
        batch_neg.append(neg)
    return np.array(batch_seq), np.array(batch_pos), np.array(batch_neg)


@torch.no_grad()
def sample_causal_candidates(seq: torch.Tensor, positive: torch.Tensor,
                             itemnum: int, count: int = 32):
    """Uniform replacement draws excluding only the visible prefix and target.

    Stable sorting makes the first matching item carry its earliest position.
    Thus membership tests do not exclude items occurring only in later positions.
    No quadratic catalog mask or B x L x K x L tensor is constructed.
    """
    batch, length = seq.shape
    positions = torch.arange(length, device=seq.device).unsqueeze(0)
    sorted_items, original_positions = torch.sort(seq, dim=1, stable=True)

    def first_occurrence(values):
        shape = values.shape
        flat = values.reshape(batch, -1).contiguous()
        index = torch.searchsorted(sorted_items.contiguous(), flat)
        index = index.clamp_max(length - 1)
        found = sorted_items.gather(1, index).eq(flat)
        first = original_positions.gather(1, index)
        return found.reshape(shape), first.reshape(shape)

    _, first_input = first_occurrence(seq)
    unique_prefix_count = (seq.ne(0) & first_input.eq(positions)).long().cumsum(1)
    found_target, first_target = first_occurrence(positive)
    target_in_prefix = found_target & first_target.le(positions)
    available = itemnum - unique_prefix_count - (~target_in_prefix).long()
    valid = seq.ne(0) & positive.ne(0)
    eligible = valid & available.gt(0)
    skipped = (valid & ~eligible).sum()
    negatives = torch.randint(1, itemnum + 1, (batch, length, count), device=seq.device)

    def rejected(draws):
        found, first = first_occurrence(draws)
        prefix_hit = found & first.le(positions.unsqueeze(-1))
        return ((prefix_hit | draws.eq(positive.unsqueeze(-1)))
                & eligible.unsqueeze(-1))

    bad = rejected(negatives)
    for _ in range(8):
        number_bad = int(bad.sum().item())
        if number_bad == 0:
            break
        negatives[bad] = torch.randint(1, itemnum + 1, (number_bad,), device=seq.device)
        bad = rejected(negatives)

    # The bounded rejection stage keeps dense-prefix cases from stalling.
    # Both accepted rejection draws and fallback draws are uniform on A.
    if bool(bad.any().item()):
        catalog = torch.arange(1, itemnum + 1, device=seq.device)
        for b, t in bad.any(dim=-1).nonzero(as_tuple=False).tolist():
            allowed = catalog[~torch.isin(catalog, seq[b, :t + 1])
                              & catalog.ne(positive[b, t])]
            mask = bad[b, t]
            n = int(mask.sum().item())
            indices = torch.randint(allowed.numel(), (n,), device=seq.device)
            negatives[b, t, mask] = allowed[indices]
    return negatives, eligible, skipped
